purpose: Pinned public source/tool audit for HAYUYA image-to-3D, humanoid reconstruction, topology, rigging, facial reconstruction, and Blender post-processing.

rules.vendor_policy: Do not copy third-party code into HAYUYA production sources. Fetch pinned upstream snapshots into an external cache and preserve upstream licenses.
rules.restricted_policy: Research-restricted tools may be cloned for audit only and must not enter a commercial/released HAYUYA pipeline without a separate license review.
rules.weights_policy: This manifest downloads source code only. Model weights/assets with separate terms are never fetched automatically.

tools.notes: Public research code from the team behind Tripo. Image-conditioned rectified-flow/SDF VAE shape generation.
SparseFlex high-resolution arbitrary-topology reconstruction/modeling; useful as a geometry quality/refinement reference.
O-Voxel image-to-3D with PBR attributes; already used by HAYUYA challenger path.
Field-aligned automatic quad retopology; keep as external executable.

tools.license: MIT source; third-party CUBVH has non-commercial/research terms
tools.notes: Directly co-generates shape, skeleton, and skin weights. Inference does not require CUBVH according to upstream; verify checkpoint terms before production.
Parametric human generator for Blender. Keep as a separate tool/process; generated outputs are described upstream as unrestricted/asset-derived.
Humanoid morph/measurement/face rig scripts. Useful as implementation reference and external Blender tooling.
Blender auto-rigging/skinning system with advanced facial rig; separate GPL tool.

tools.license: Tencent Hunyuan terms / non-commercial constraints may apply
tools.notes: Open shape + PBR texture pipeline including remesh, UV wrapping, multiview normal/position conditioning, super-resolution, bake and inpaint.
SMPL-X-guided clothed human reconstruction from a single image; close match to the 'fit a base human then reconstruct clothing' hypothesis.

tools.license: MIT code; SMPL-X body models have separate terms
tools.notes: Single-view textured human reconstruction with SMPL-X fitting, back hallucination, and mesh reconstruction.

tools.license: non-commercial scientific research; FLAME assets separate
tools.notes: Single-image detailed animatable face reconstruction. Valuable algorithm reference for face/head-specific refinement.
Single-image mesh reconstruction with UV unwrapping, delight/material prediction, and optional triangle/quad remeshing.

blender_builtins.notes: Blender's standard automatic rigging system includes a face rig. No vendoring required.

blender_builtins.license: Blender source tree terms / upstream QuadriFlow components
blender_builtins.notes: Built into Blender for quad remeshing; no need to clone the entire Blender source tree.
